fields.name: Mapping attribute
fields.definition: A provider-specific attribute on a model property, such as `MapToSqlNVarChar` or `MapToPgVarchar`. It declares the parameter or column name the property binds to, the database type, type options (length, precision, scale, locale) and the optional required flag. The property's .NET type must match the attribute's database type exactly; the Mapper never casts. Properties without a mapping attribute are ignored. The Mapper reads these attributes to build its compiled mapping delegates.
